race.description: Ladies Of Brian Hilton Wyong Provincial Mdn Hcp
race.comment: LACONIC LIVO (6) resumes for his second prep. Struck trouble at the start on debut from a wide gate and never got into the contest when last over 1100m at Randwick Kensington last April. Primed with the two trials and can play a leading role. CHEEKY SORT (9) six-start Maiden resuming after showing ability at this level when last in work. Deep into the prep with a tiring fifth over 1100m at Canterbury last April. Sharpened with a trial placing over 900m. Can pull out a big run fresh. EXTREME COURAGE (14) back from a lengthy break when he closed off strongly to secure second at Kembla Grange over 1000m. Gets a much better set up today and not without top three claims. AREESEA (8) trained locally and resumes with the two trials under the belt. One for the exotics.
